platforms.name: Google
platforms.spend_scope: Weekly account spending and cumulative state spending
limits: State amounts cover all dates in the archive; they cannot be filtered to 2026 or recent weeks.
Account weekly totals cover complete source weeks, across all account audiences. No exact 7/30-day prorating.
Creative spending ranges are lifetime ranges, never recent-period spending.
Targeting footprints count distinct advertisers naming a location; dollars are not allocated to ZIP targets.
Cities, radii and unmatched targets remain in ad details; no invented local boundaries.
Only explicit ZIP / state / recognised congressional criteria colour the footprint map. Nationwide criteria are optional.

platforms.name: Snapchat
limits: Spend is campaign-to-date and can include campaigns begun before 2026; it is not a 2026-only or recent 7/30-day figure.
A future EndDate is a campaign schedule, not proof of impressions in the future.
Spending currencies are preserved. Non-USD spending is excluded from USD summaries.
Buyer, declared payer and committee combinations stay separate so an agency does not become one candidate campaign.
The location map counts distinct advertisers with reported included criteria; it does not measure local spending or impressions.
Unresolved electoral districts, metros and radius criteria remain visible in source details. Exclusions are preserved.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.spend_scope: Verified spending upper bound · partial coverage
limits: One verified 2026 staff disclosure does not establish complete platform coverage.
Spending is an upper bound for the entire disclosure, not an amount to repeat for each creative.
The disclosure is from June–July; no current October spending or weekly series is established.
The advertiser is an issue organisation with no verified candidate or FEC committee attribution.

platforms.name: X
limits: The officially linked download returned 404 through web retrieval and 403 on direct requests.
No current spending data is loaded. Unavailable coverage is not zero spending.

method: Separate platform amounts, source dates, spending kinds and geographic scopes; no incompatible totals are added.
identity_method: Exact reported FEC committee IDs or unique declared payer / committee names matched to an authorised candidate committee. Google also allows an exact unique candidate name with matching primary source affiliation. PACs retain their own identities.
